signature.caption: video proof, not line reads
signature.why: Our pick: rather than read the diff, he asks the agent in its orb to prove the work end to end, often with a video.
signature.quote: “I want you to go and test this end-to-end, I don’t care how, and give me irrefutable proof that this works. Dazzle me. Give me a video as proof, or something.”

archetype.why: Runs Amp agents in remote orbs that start and check on other agents. He spot-checks the results.

signature_quote.value: These agents in orbs now look like async functions to me, less like remote controlled agents.
